subject: Film & Cinema
title: The Nine Old Men: Disney's Master Animators
description: A quick, practical guide to The Nine Old Men: Disney's Master Animators.

hook.text: Nine animators at Disney created rules so fundamental that they're still taught in every school.

buildup.text: They codified the 12 Principles of Animation — squash and stretch, anticipation, staging, and more.

discovery.text: These principles make animated movement feel alive, weighted, and emotionally expressive.

twist.text: The principles work for 3D CGI just as well as 2D hand-drawn — they're universal.

climax.text: Every Pixar, Ghibli, and indie animation still follows rules written in the 1930s.

punchline.text: Nine men wrote animation's permanent constitution.

quiz.question: How many Principles of Animation did the Nine Old Men codify?
